caseAssertions.normal-input: each generated content class maps to one canonical root
caseAssertions.invalid-input: unknown or ambiguous ownership is quarantined, not guessed
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: guidance cannot authorize delete, rename, Git, Unity, network, or release
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: re-reading the same path yields the same classification
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: classification can resume without destructive cleanup
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: the same path and purpose produce the same root
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: changed authority guidance requires fresh classification

responsibilityScope: AI-generated content placement and Local/Public folder guidance only.

specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Runtime is not required to prove folder ownership routing or path refusal.
